truths.truth: The prompt hook never injects a tool-result turn (a user turn with is_typed 0): a planted Read result never reaches its output, and the Read tool-call turn still fires
truths.evidence: prompt.rs:578-596 quotable drops record_type='user' AND is_typed=0 by turn id; wired in selected at prompt.rs:441, after eligible (:436) and before within/surviving (:442-450), and a failed lookup injects nothing (unwrap_or_default). Hook path: hook.rs:254 -> prompt::user_prompt_submit (prompt.rs:216-232) -> selected -> render. Test a_read_result_is_never_injected_but_the_read_still_fires passes; its premise asserts both the call and the result rank in the top 3 with an entity match, so the result was eligible without the step. Binary probe on a scratch store with the real Read result shape: terminus search (no exclusion on that surface) shows the result's excerpt carrying PLANTED7f3a, while hook UserPromptSubmit for the same file prints only the Read tool-call line and no PLANTED7f3a. The fail-before half was not re-run by mutation here (that would edit the tree); it rests on that premise and the plan 1 report.

truths.truth: Both hooks put every quoted string between one fixed <terminus-recall> pair under a quoted-history header, and a closer planted in an excerpt, day, project label or branch in another case, with whitespace or zero-width chars inside, fullwidth, lookalike punctuation or non-ASCII letters is neutralized, leaving the closing tag once, at the end
truths.evidence: inject/mod.rs:221-249 (OPEN_TAG, CLOSE_TAG, QUOTED_HISTORY, NEUTRALIZED), :281-454 (neutralize), :482-492 (frame). Prompt arm: excerpts are neutralized after redaction and before flatten/window via excerpt::attach_scrubbed (prompt.rs:479-485, excerpt.rs:211-224), the day at prompt.rs:322, and frame at :288. Brief: of_record_scrubbed at brief.rs:575, project/day/branch at :424-430, pointer label at :631, frame at :233/:253. Tests pass: a_closing_tag_planted_in_a_firing_turn_is_neutralized (9 variants plus a fullwidth closer across byte 10 of ts), a_closing_tag_planted_in_any_archived_string_is_neutralized (8 spans across prompt, reply, branch, cwd twice, day), and 31 lib inject:: unit tests. recall_golden passes and only the two == brief sections changed, so search/context/get did not move. Binary probe: a U+200B-split closer in an assistant turn came out as [closing tag removed] in additionalContext. Cross-boundary closers between an archived string and the fixed text after it fail on the fixed ASCII separators ('): ', '\n- turn', ' ended', ',', '\nIt last').

truths.truth: No archived text can close the delimiter: a closer split by an invisible ASCII control character is neutralized like one split by U+200B
truths.evidence: inject/mod.rs:452-454 is_ignorable is c.is_whitespace() || !c.is_ascii(), so U+0000-0008, U+000E-001F and U+007F break the match, and excerpt.rs:236-251 flatten keeps them. Probe of the real neutralizer source: </term U+0000 inus-recall>, </terminus U+001F -recall>, </terminus- U+001B recall>, </terminus-rec U+007F all> and < U+0007 /terminus-recall> all come back unchanged, while the U+200B form becomes [closing tag removed]. End to end through target/debug/terminus hook UserPromptSubmit: the U+001F and U+001B closers reach additionalContext intact mid-block, so the output carries two closer-shaped spans once the control char is dropped.

gaps.name: A closing tag split by an invisible ASCII control character passes the neutralizer
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - the phase treats invisible chars inside a closer as still closing it (U+200B is neutralized), but invisible ASCII controls are not ignorable, so the same attack with U+001F, U+001B, U+0000 or U+007F reaches the model intact. ROADMAP criterion 2 asks for a delimiter no excerpt text can close.
gaps.evidence: crates/terminus-core/src/inject/mod.rs:452-454 is_ignorable is c.is_whitespace() || !c.is_ascii(), which leaves out U+0000-0008, U+000E-001F and U+007F. crates/terminus-core/src/recall/excerpt.rs:236-251 flatten keeps them. Probe of the real neutralize source returned </terminus U+001F -recall>, </terminus- U+001B recall>, </term U+0000 inus-recall> and </terminus-rec U+007F all> unchanged. target/debug/terminus hook UserPromptSubmit on a scratch store put the U+001F and U+001B closers into additionalContext mid-block, while the U+200B form came out as [closing tag removed]. The same rule covers the day, branch and project label. Whether a model reads such a span as a closer is unmeasured, the same as for U+200B.

Update THREAT-MODEL.md:149 and 0007-injection.md:90/:118 to match.
